# JINGOX
> JINGOX is the wholesale brand of Shenzhen Zhimi Technology Co., Ltd., a Shenzhen, China source factory and trading partner for wholesale gaming console accessories. It supplies ready catalog items and OEM/ODM custom products for Nintendo Switch 2, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation (PS5 / Slim / Pro, PS4), Xbox and VR/Meta Quest platforms.

Key facts for buyers:
- Business model: B2B wholesale and OEM/ODM only. The site is a pure inquiry site — no online shopping cart, no payment, no published retail prices; pricing is provided per quote.
- Minimum order: 1 piece for ready catalog products; a single sample is accepted. Custom OEM projects have a separate MOQ based on the model and customization level.
- Main product categories: charging docks, cooling stands, controller and console storage, somatosensory/sports kits, faceplates, protective cases and storage bags.
- OEM/ODM: custom color, logo, retail packaging, bundled sets and custom product development are supported.
- Quality: every order is backed by material and function checks and consistent specifications; EMC and RoHS test reports are available for eligible models on request.
- Contact: send an inquiry through the contact page, message on WhatsApp, or call +86 18002528191. Replies with MOQ and pricing are sent within one business day.
